canada.title: People gather in Winnipeg for Manitoba's largest Remembrance Day ceremony
canada.summary: People gathered in Winnipeg on Wednesday for a Remembrance Day ceremony at the RBC Convention Centre. The annual service, hosted by the Joint Veterans Association, typically draws thousands of attendees.

canada.title: Parks Canada to shut down 3 northern warden detachments, centralize in Yellowknife
canada.summary: Kluane National Park and Reserve in Yukon, Nahanni National Park Reserve in N.W.T., and Wood Buffalo National Park in N.W.T. and Alberta will lose their detachments.

canada.title: Montreal marks Remembrance Day with ceremony
canada.summary: Montrealers looking to pay their respects for Remembrance Day have several options in and around the city on Wednesday.

canada.title: Sask. WW II vet says laughter helped him live to 100
canada.summary: One of increasingly few surviving Second World War veterans, John Watson still attends all the Remembrance Day ceremonies in Swift Current, Sask. He also recently returned to the Netherlands to mark the anniversary of its liberation.

canada.title: 2 Mississauga men charged after allegedly stealing 9 coffee machines valued at nearly $86K: police
canada.summary: Two Mississauga men have been arrested and charged after allegedly stealing nine commercial coffee machines valued at nearly $86,000, Peel police say. Six of the machines have been recovered, while three remain outstanding.

canada.title: Police genealogy team IDs British man who died in Toronto 34 years ago
canada.summary: Months of work by Toronto police's genealogy team and investigators have unmasked a man who died in the city's downtown in 1992.

canada.title: City takes Fredericton Exhibition settlement dispute to court
canada.summary: Fredericton council voted Monday night to take the expropriation process for the Exhibition Grounds to court as both sides have been unable to reach a payment deal.

canada.title: N.S. group apologizes for including woman convicted in a brutal killing on a panel
canada.summary: The Elizabeth Fry Society of Mainland Nova Scotia is apologizing after it hosted a panel discussion on violence that featured Marissa Shephard. Shephard was sentenced to 12 years in prison after she pleaded guilty to manslaughter and arson in the death of Baylee Wylie.

canada.title: Crowchild Trail reopened after rollover crash forced morning shutdown
canada.summary: Crowchild Trail in southwest Calgary has been reopened to traffic after a single-vehicle rollover led to a closure from Marda Loop to 17th Avenue S.W. early Wednesday morning.

canada.title: Future of 66-year-old McMahon Stadium in the spotlight ahead of Grey Cup
canada.summary: The 66-year-old building will host the Canadian Football League's championship game Sunday between the Edmonton Elks and Montreal Alouettes.

canada.title: Saskatoon judge delivers 20-year sentence for ‘absolutely abhorrent’ killing
canada.summary: One of the three people responsible for a gruesome 2024 Saskatoon homicide has been sentenced to 20 years behind bars on charges of manslaughter and indignity to human remains.

canada.title: Parts of B.C. could be without power for days as storm continues to batter province
canada.summary: B.C. Hydro is warning that some drenched areas of the province could be without power for days, as a fall storm continued to make its presence felt on Wednesday.

canada.title: Fresh Prep approved to purchase Montreal-based competitor Goodfood
canada.summary: Fresh Prep refused to disclose how much it will pay for Goodfood but says the deal is expected to close on or around Friday.

canada.title: Rain hammering B.C. south coast may taper, but more on the way: meteorologist
canada.summary: Drenching rain that has been soaking southern British Columbia for days could ease Wednesday— but the reprieve might be short-lived, with yet another storm system on the way.

canada.title: N.W.T. sports review highlights uneven playing field for small communities
canada.summary: A review of the N.W.T.'s participation in large, multisport events has found that many survey respondents believe athletes from outside Yellowknife aren’t getting an equal shot at competing on the big stage.

canada.title: What's open, closed around Halifax for Remembrance Day
canada.summary: Under Nova Scotia's Remembrance Day Act, some retail businesses must be closed Nov. 11, including malls, big-box stores and grocery stores.

canada.title: Ukrainian war veteran from Manitoba's Interlake walks the walk in fundraising campaign
canada.summary: Ukrainian war veteran Peter Derksen has completed a nearly six-month and over 4,000 kilometre hike on the Pacific Crest Trail, travelling on foot from the U.S.-Mexico border to Canada as part of a personal fundraising campaign for the ongoing war effort.

canada.title: Website saves Royal Canadian Navy history from being 'buried forever'
canada.summary: Garry Weir's genealogy website began with a small section helping people find military records for loved ones. It has since morphed into a sprawling archive dedicated to Royal Canadian Navy history.
